release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.16 replaces the text-only Casino presentation with graphical felt tables, illustrated playing-card faces and backs, visual chip tokens, separate Blackjack and Punto Banco layouts, and staged card-reveal animations. The existing six-deck Blackjack and standard Baccarat payout rules are unchanged. A one-time $270.00 refund for the initial casino UI test is credited to the existing local wallet with an atomic ledger entry; it does not reset the wallet or change poker P&L. NL500/NL1000, the immutable 174-situation preflop chart, postflop reasoning, and Hold'em Run It Twice are preserved.
